mapper.select: SELECT d.date, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS reservation_count, COUNT(po.checkout_id) FILTER (WHERE po.payment_order_status = 'SUCCESS') AS payment_count, COALESCE(SUM(po.amount) FILTER (WHERE po.payment_order_status = 'SUCCESS'),0) AS payment_total FROM generate_series( CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '13 days', CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1 day' ) AS d(date) LEFT JOIN reservation r ON DATE(r.created_at) = d.date LEFT JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.reservation_id = r.id LEFT JOIN payment_order po ON po.checkout_id = pe.checkout_id GROUP BY d.date ORDER BY d.date;
